overall_summary: The channel shows clear outlier performance for husband-wife relationship themes (Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar... and Wife Emotional Video both pulled >1,600 views), significantly outperforming generic shayari, family members (sister/brother/father), and self-motivation shorts which mostly lingered under 300 views. However, overall sample size is low, necessitating a focus on proven relational dynamics while keeping a small experimental edge.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life dynamics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') generated 1,767 and 1,674 views respectively, drastically higher than any other category.
winning_patterns.action: Prioritize narrative concepts touching upon unspoken marital friction, lost romance after marriage, or mutual understanding between partners.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Heavy Shayari & Raw Text Quotes
weak_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views, showing poor pull compared to conversational, relatable relationship questions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely abstract, poetic, or overly dramatic poetic titles; ground every video in a specific, everyday domestic or emotional scenario.
